subject: Welcome to TrueCap — your first deal in 60 seconds
preheader: Paste an address and review cap rate, cash flow, selected-rule fit, and a secondary Screening Index.
headline: You're in. Here's how to get value in the next 60 seconds.
body: Welcome to TrueCap. The whole idea: paste any U.S. address and review cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, monthly cash flow, selected-rule fit, and a secondary Screening Index — in about a minute. Rent, mortgage rate, and property tax can start from labeled estimates, and you can edit anything. Verify every material input before relying on the result.
Try it on a property you're actually looking at right now. The fastest way to see if TrueCap fits how you work is to run a real deal, not a sample.
Reply to this email and tell me what you're hunting for — market, strategy, price range. I read every one.
